title: Hinton's name game: Cliff Leeman, Ray McKinley, Gene Krupa
summary: Hinton names drummers and Jones names their bands, including Leeman, McKinley and Krupa at Buddy Rogers's band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: You see, these great drummers—this is this game I wanted to play—they seem to have done what you say... Because of all of these great drummers, I'll name the drummer and you name the band, because all of these bands happen to turn out to be famous bands. We'll start with some white drummers. Yes. Then he decided to do novelty songs and then he became a singer, got up from the drums, and then he went out with the band and he began to sing.
This is a word game - you name the band. Gene Krupa?

Gene, really the first time that he took my notice was when he was with Buddy Rogers. You know, Buddy was playing the multiple, and he'd run around and play all the instruments; and I'm in Minneapolis looking at him. I was late on my job, the first time in my life I was ever late on my job with Grant Moore, watching Gene. I went back stage and saw him. Then I found out about some of his background and who he hung out with and he knew about everybody else, but I said social conditions being what they were. Then when Benny Goodman organized, then they get Gene.
